User-authorized required process-slot extension. Atmospheric-pressure natural/forced-convection laboratory ovens for drying, ageing and thermal curing. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. Laboratory uniaxial mechanical/hydraulic compression presses, with unheated or heated platens/dies for compaction, pellet making, lamination and hot compression. Excludes nanoimprint lithography M60 and SPS category M69. Heated operation is model/configuration dependent. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. General laboratory nonplanetary grinding and mortar systems for dry/wet size reduction, powder mixing and sample preparation. Record mechanism explicitly: pressure/friction mortar grinders differ from cutting/impact batch mills. Excludes high-energy planetary mills in M12; category membership does not establish nano-size output. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. In-line diffusion or membrane dryer that removes solvent vapor from an aerosol without intentionally collecting its particles. Distinct from spray dryers and compressed-air dryers. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. Aerosol neutralizer or charger that establishes a controlled particle-charge distribution before electrical-mobility classification. Bipolar and unipolar instruments require the matching measurement model. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. Condensation particle counter or aerosol electrometer used to detect/count particles or measure particle-borne charge after classification. Electrometers require a known charge state to infer particle count. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. Impaction or electrostatic collection apparatus that captures aerosol particles onto substrates for recovery or offline analysis; selecting a collector requires the relevant size range, flow and collection substrate. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. Complete systems that produce, select, accelerate and deliver an ion beam into a solid substrate for implantation or material modification. Excludes generic plasma etchers, ion-milling-only tools and ion-source components. Selection of catalyst species, dose, substrate and end station requires model-specific review. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. Integrated metal melting/alloying and casting systems with suitable mould/crucible hardware, atmosphere control and casting arrangement; includes vacuum/inert induction and arc-melting systems with casting options. Distinct from annealing-only induction heaters. Alloy chemistry, reactivity, casting dimensions and optional hardware must be checked. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. Purpose-built presses that force a metal billet through a die to make elongated rods, wire, tubes or profiles. Excludes CNC machining, rolling mills, polymer-only screw extruders and generic presses without documented metal extrusion capability. Alloy, die, billet heater, extrusion ratio and force must be checked. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. Reaction chambers/flow cells and their optical coupling for nanoparticle laser ablation in liquids. Laser source remains M56. Laboratory custom builds require configuration-specific engineering; analytical LA-ICP-MS cells are not assumed suitable. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized implementation, 2026-10-17. Manual/electronic pipettes and dispensers, plus automated pipetting workstations; complements pumps M07 and general robots M62. Candidate for transfers and feed preparation; no pipette model is asserted by the source rows. Market alternatives are not source-paper apparatus or validated process configurations.

User-authorized implementation, 2026-10-17. Magnetic racks, separators and flow-through magnetic recovery assemblies. P33 step 4 is an optional characterization-preparation branch, not a universal production requirement. Representative magnetic-bead racks are not validated for the cited magnetite formulation. Market alternatives are not source-paper apparatus or validated process configurations.

categories.category_name: Two-photon lithography and micro/nano printing systems
categories.association_basis: Two-photon/multiphoton polymerization and grayscale direct laser writing; excludes UV mask aligners and electron-beam writers. Alternative two-photon photopolymer branch in P06, not a drop-in replacement for the electron-beam/metal recipe. Compatible resist, development and geometry must be chosen; no automatic metal etch/transfer requirement.

Grid plunge/jet/blotless vitrification for cryo-TEM of hydrated dispersions; excludes bulk high-pressure freezers and freeze dryers. Optional grid vitrification before TEM verification of hydrated dispersions. Selecting this class requires a cryo-TEM configuration in the M39 verification slot. Not bulk freezing or freeze drying.

Complete SQUID and VSM magnetic-property systems, including configured PPMS+VSM; not particle separation magnets or Hall-only gaussmeters. Optional magnetic-moment/hysteresis verification of magnetite; not magnetic separation or a synthesis operation.

Inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy for elemental analysis of prepared/digested samples. Not ICP-MS or UV-visible absorption. Optional elemental composition/concentration after suitable digestion, dilution and calibration. Not particle-size or phase measurement.

Mechanical stylus surface height, film thickness and roughness measurement; distinct from optical profilometry and AFM. Optional contact profilometry of accessible films/steps; stylus force, film damage, roughness and substrate suitability require review. Not AFM or optical profilometry.

Instrumented nanoindentation/nanoscratch platforms for nanoscale mechanical response; equipment configuration and sample preparation determine suitability. Optional mechanical response of suitably prepared nanostructured bulk/composite surfaces; indentation depth, substrate and polishing effects require review.

Surface elemental and chemical-state analysis using XPS/ESCA; not powder X-ray diffraction. Optional surface elemental/chemical-state analysis; vacuum compatibility and transfer/contamination are sample-specific. Not bulk composition or XRD.

Surface elemental/chemical-state analysis by Auger electron spectroscopy. Not XPS or SEM-EDS. Vacuum, sample and beam-damage constraints remain model-specific. Optional local surface elemental mapping for vacuum-compatible specimens; charging and beam damage must be checked. Not XPS or SEM-EDS.

categories.category_name: Quartz crystal microbalance with dissipation monitoring
categories.association_basis: QCM instruments that measure dissipation in addition to frequency. Includes ring-down QCM-D and explicitly labelled bandwidth/impedance-derived dissipation; measurement methods are distinguished. Frequency-only QCM is excluded. Optional adsorption/assembly monitoring on a compatible sensor. QCM-D frequency/dissipation response is not an unqualified particle mass or an electrochemical-cell substitute.

Bulk, handheld or micro-XRF elemental analysis with element range and calibration specific to configuration. TRACER III cannot quantify carbon; trace-metal screening does not identify nanoparticle size. Optional bulk metal composition screening with suitable elemental range/calibration. Does not measure carbon content on TRACER III or nanoparticle size.

X-ray micro/nano-CT and 3D X-ray microscopy. Spatial resolution differs from voxel size; only features resolvable for the model, sample and contrast can be interpreted. Optional 3D inspection of resolvable pores/cracks in bulk nanostructured parts. Voxel size is not spatial resolution; individual nanoparticles may be unresolved.

Integrated MBE growth systems; source/cracker/plasma configurations must match the material system. Not CVD, ALD or sputtering. UCLA capability review; no universal recipe or validated model substitution.

Spectrograph components used within PL benches. Excitation sources, detectors, collection optics and cryostats remain separate; a bare spectrograph is not a complete PL system. UCLA capability review; no universal recipe or validated model substitution.

categories.category_name: Semiconductor electrical and optoelectronic probe stations

I–V device characterization electronics. Not electrochemical potentiostats or mechanical test systems. UCLA capability review; no universal recipe or validated model substitution.

Electrical component/device capacitance, inductance and impedance measurement. Not optical spectroscopy or electrochemical-cell control. UCLA capability review; no universal recipe or validated model substitution.

Phase-sensitive detection electronics used within a configured measurement chain. Not an autonomous PL spectrometer or process controller. UCLA capability review; no universal recipe or validated model substitution.

Photon-event timing electronics; optical wavelength range depends on external detectors and optics. Not a stand-alone spectrometer or light source. UCLA capability review; no universal recipe or validated model substitution.

Cryogenic sample environments for optical measurement, distinct from grid vitrification, freeze drying and growth furnaces. UCLA capability review; no universal recipe or validated model substitution.

FTIR microscope/optical sampling hardware requiring a compatible spectrometer. Does not independently replace a complete FTIR spectrometer. UCLA capability review; no universal recipe or validated model substitution.

In-line mass analysis and selection of nanoparticle beams in vacuum. Distinct from aerosol electrical-mobility classifiers, particle detectors and complete nanoparticle sources. Manufacturer catalogue relevance plus curator classification; exact host-system compatibility and process suitability require configuration review.

Sample positioning, rotation, bias and thermal-environment accessories inside compatible UHV systems. Not a general robot, growth chamber, furnace or complete deposition system. In-flight shell-coating modules for previously generated nanoparticle beams. Requires a compatible source and host vacuum chamber; not a complete substrate sputter coater or nanoparticle generator. Manufacturer catalogue relevance plus curator classification; exact host-system compatibility and process suitability require configuration review.

Digital optical exposure without a photomask. Not a mask aligner, electron-beam writer or nanoimprint press. Micrometre lateral patterning capability does not establish nanoscale resolution.
